notes:
Inbound trial — signed up via self-serve hosted API. Product: in-app chat assistant for B2B SaaS support. Key context: latency-sensitive: target p50 token streaming <200ms for agent-side inference; p95 <500ms. Using streaming to progressively render tokens in UI. Current prototype calls single-shot generate per user message; looking to move to streaming API to reduce perceived latency.

Developer feedback from initial trial: 'response feels snappy but we want lower tail latency — especially for 8–12 token re-sponses that drive UI typing effect.' Interested in models that support fast short-turn responses (instruction-following, ~3–6 tok avg). Cost sensitivity flagged: early stage, freemium conversion dependent on infra cost.

Security: needs SSO/SAML for internal admin, SOC2 compliance evidence, audit logs. No VPC/on-prem requirement at this stage — public cloud is fine. Data retention: default retention OK but need ability to export logs for audits.

Model routing: would like an auto-fallback to smaller quantized model when load spikes (preserve UX). Also interested in prefix caching for common utterances. Mentioned wanting simple SDK examples for streaming + reconnect semantics.

Timeline / activity summary in CRM: see timeline entries. Rep notes: very technical founders (CTO is ex-front-end infra), cares about SDK ergonomics and minimal integration work.

Stated quote from demo: 'We could ship this next sprint if we can guarantee streaming latency and a neat SDK.'
